lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\MarkdownSite\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

lines: vendor/ ships 4 packages that the server ships itself in a major of Nextcloud 31 to 34. Both copies define the same classes, and the autoloader that is asked first decides which version runs.

symfony/polyfill-ctype v1.37.0, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 31
symfony/polyfill-php80 v1.37.0, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 31

phpunit/phpunit is in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.
